answer: Each agent must cultivate an oasis in the violet desert: the beacon emits a vertex seed each epoch, and the agent must prove continuous presence by staking water tokens. The first well costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent well doubles the cost (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at well 14 (20.4 M iterations). A violet audit verifies each well against the vertex seed; any dry well voids the oasis. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full oasis cost because each well binds to the unique identity key—no water sharing possible.
